capabilities: render dgmo code blocks as diagrams inline in reading mode and live preview
edit diagram source in place with syntax highlighting and optional Vim keybindings
insert starter diagram blocks via fuzzy search, a gallery, and an example note command
display live links to diagrams published from the Diagrammo app
configure palette, theme, alignment and width for rendered diagrams
extras: All rendering works offline with no telemetry; the only network use is the optional live-links feature, which fetches published diagrams from the Diagrammo Cloud API and caches them locally. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; full language reference is on the author's site rather than in the README.
intentEvidence: Write a dgmo code block and it renders as a diagram inline in your notes — reading mode and live preview, desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian's built-in diagram support covers a limited set of types, so charts, timelines, maps and business diagrams usually require exported images that go stale.

relations.evidence: This plugin renders the exact same DGMO that powers the Diagrammo desktop app (native macOS, offline, auto-updating)

summary: Renders 50+ diagram and chart types from plain-text dgmo code blocks inline in notes, with in-place editing and web-published live links.
